name: Chunk Rendering with Multidraw Indirect
aliases: GPU Instanced Voxel Rendering via DrawMeshInstancedIndirect
MegaSSBO Indirect Rendering with Instance Encoding
definition: A rendering technique for voxel worlds that batches chunk rendering using OpenGL's `glMultiDrawElementsIndirect` to reduce draw call overhead, storing chunk geometry in a large shared VBO and using indirect commands to specify per-chunk offsets and counts.
